development_notice: Development reference · not a public release announcement

sections.title: Local development build
paragraphs: This local development build includes the game features below. Its version is shown at the end of this page. Optional online features depend on a configured service and may be unavailable.

sections.title: Implemented game and comfort features
paragraphs: The client includes the main fleet and Rechart, offline settlement and recovery, six restoration chapters, eighteen archive entries, twelve calibrations, twelve challenge dossiers, and a separate seasonal fleet with pass progression.

It also includes free shared-slot crew briefings, automation plans, collection appearances, reduced motion, larger text, separate audio controls, and opt-in local reminders with quiet hours. Purchases and rewarded ads appear only through their configured, verified service paths.

sections.title: Current development improvements
paragraphs: The handbook now explains reset retention, offline limits, Note spending and recovery. Long headings and confirmations wrap and scroll at larger text sizes.
Note-spending guidance distinguishes campaign dossiers from optional plan slots and decorations. Choosing optional purchases first can postpone a needed dossier.

sections.title: Unavailable services
paragraphs: Online account recovery, verified purchases, rewarded ads and soundtrack downloads may be unavailable. The game shows their configured status; local play and free crew briefings remain available.
Available public help pages are listed below. Opening an account deletion page does not itself delete an account.
